syncIntervalSeconds.description: Synchronization interval seconds. Must be between 60 and 3600.

allowedNamespaces.description: Allowed namespaces when clusterWide is false

RegisterClusterRequest.description: Cluster registration request. KUBECONFIG is preferred. Use SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN when kubeconfig is not available or not supported.

credentialType.description: Credential type. Prefer KUBECONFIG. Use SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN as fallback.

kubeconfig.description: kubeconfig YAML content. Required when credentialType is KUBECONFIG.

serviceAccount.description: ServiceAccount token credential. Required when credentialType is SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN.

syncIntervalSeconds.description: Sync interval seconds. Default is 300 seconds.

kubernetesVersion.description: Kubernetes version returned by the API server

namespaces.description: Sample namespace names visible to the configured credential

StartAnalysisJobResponse.description: AI analysis async job start response

ClusterCredentialResponse.description: Cluster credential payload. Masked by default; reveal=true returns the stored plaintext credential and writes an audit log.
